sources.prompt: Create ORIGINAL native pixel-art animation sprites, matching the supplied local reference character identity and costume. Deliver ONE transparent PNG atlas in portrait layout, EXACTLY 4 columns by 8 rows = 32 complete full-body character poses, left-to-right chronological four-frame sequences in each row. Native desired size 1024 x 2048, each cell 256 x 256. Every pose unique, fully inside its own cell with at least 18px empty transparent margin on every side. Empty transparent gutters between cells, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no backgrounds, no watermarks, no UI. Cohesive detailed retro 2D fighting-game sprite style with crisp pixel clusters, compact readable anatomy, consistent character height and proportions. All action faces toward the RIGHT; poses can rotate slightly but preserve lateral game-readable silhouette. Entire body and all attached effects must fit inside each cell. Transparent background including spaces inside effects. At most one main character plus explicitly requested illusory effect in each cell. Eight rows, in EXACT order: row 1 intro, row 2 outro, row 3 roundVictory, row 4 roundDefeat, row 5 fatality/non-gory character-specific finale, row 6 full victory, row 7 full defeat, row 8 super. Non-gory harmless defeat, no blood or wounds, no victims/opponents, no text. These are adapted game animation frames, not copies of original game assets. Do not reuse any identical pose across rows, and do not mechanically mirror or recolor poses. All 32 poses genuinely drawn individually. ONLY young NARUTO UZUMAKI from the original Naruto Part I (approximately 12–13 years old), exactly the attached reference: short spiky yellow hair, blue eyes, three whisker marks each cheek, blue Konoha forehead protector with metal plate, original ORANGE jacket with NAVY BLUE shoulder yoke and cream upright collar, orange trousers, blue open-toed ninja sandals, right thigh pouch. No Shippuden black/orange outfit. No adult proportions, no red cloak, no Six Paths, no Rasenshuriken, no giant fox. Keep original innocent energetic youthful face. ROW 1 INTRO: 1 step forward, 2 tighten forehead protector with both hands, 3 lower hands lively grin, 4 settle in low guarded stance. ROW 2 OUTRO: 1 relax guard, 2 glance back and make short friendly hand sign, 3 pivot away, 4 launch into ninja exit run. ROW 3 ROUND VICTORY: 1 straighten from crouch, 2 quick upward fist pump, 3 proud hip-and-fist stance, 4 relaxed guard with satisfied grin. ROW 4 ROUND DEFEAT: 1 recoil backwards with open hands, 2 stagger with bent knee, 3 one knee down with hand supporting ground, 4 start rising with determined face. ROW 5 NON-GORY FINALE — original Rasengan close-range finish: 1 low crouch with hands preparing spinning blue chakra, 2 rise with blue sphere held near waist, 3 forceful forward palm lunge with compact circular spiral at palm (not a beam, no star-shaped projectile), 4 braced follow-through with dissolving chakra wisps. ROW 6 FULL VICTORY: 1 exhale and straighten, 2 broad grin with thumb pointed at chest, 3 both hands behind head in satisfied pose, 4 casual cheerful two-finger salute. ROW 7 FULL DEFEAT: 1 drained kneel leaning forward, 2 both palms on ground, 3 turn to resting side, 4 lying peacefully on side exhausted, eyes closed, unharmed. ROW 8 SUPER — distinct Rasengan sequence: 1 wide planted stance with left palm circling the chakra-forming right hand, 2 compact bright sky-blue rotating spherical Rasengan in right palm while other hand stabilizes, 3 dash low with the sphere thrust forward in right palm toward right, 4 finishing standing forward stance with right palm extended and only small fading blue spirals. No beam, no thrown disc. Finale row5 and super row8 must use 8 visibly different poses.

ONLY young SAKURA HARUNO from Naruto Part I, SHORT pink hair as after Forest of Death (approximately 12–13 years old), exactly attached local reference. Youthful green-eyed face, navy Konoha forehead protector used as hairband at crown, original SLEEVELESS RED QIPAO-STYLE TUNIC/DRESS with white piping and white circle motifs, navy blue fitted shorts underneath, pale bandage wraps at wrists/forearms, blue open-toed ninja sandals, small thigh pouch. ROW 2 OUTRO: 1 relax shoulders, 2 friendly small bow, 3 turn with gentle wave, 4 careful walking exit. ROW 3 ROUND VICTORY: 1 straighten relieved, 2 draw one small victorious fist to chest without punching, 3 smile with one hand on hip, 4 calm attentive ready pose. ROW 4 ROUND DEFEAT: 1 stumble surprised hands out, 2 lower onto one knee, 3 supporting palm on ground catching breath, 4 determined recovery half-rise. ROW 6 FULL VICTORY: 1 deep calm exhale hands at heart, 2 satisfied smile and shoulder stretch, 3 bright friendly wave, 4 poised peaceful hands-at-waist stance. ROW 7 FULL DEFEAT: 1 exhausted knees on ground, 2 seated leaning gently on one palm, 3 curl to resting side, 4 peaceful unharmed lying exhausted pose with eyes closed. ROW 8 SUPER — distinct Bunshin support sequence: 1 feet planted wide with clear crossed-finger hand seal, 2 small white harmless smoke puff and a faint identical pink-haired silhouette appearing beside real Sakura, 3 real Sakura shifts into balanced defense while semi-transparent illusion stands serenely with hands together (NOT attacking), 4 illusion visibly breaks into soft transparent white wisps while real Sakura keeps composed defensive stance. Cells of row8 must have different real body poses and clone staging from row5. All smoke stays small and pale, not an explosive damage effect.
